newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI LUJIAZUI INTERIM DOWN 67 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI LUJIAZUI INTERIM DOWN 67 PCT.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1996 figures)
Net asset per share 2.98 yuan vs 3.49 yuan
Earnings per share 0.13 yuan vs 0.75 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone Development Co Ltd.
Note: the results were contained in a company statement published by the Shanghai stock exchange on Friday.
The figures are unaudited as Chinese securities rules do not require listed firms to have their interim results audited.
Trading in the company's A and B shares would be suspended on next Monday morning, the statement said.
